scope: Authentication refresh-token rotation, reuse detection, concurrent-session limits, and role-specific session lifetime audit

sourceEvidence.finding: Creates opaque random session tokens and persists SHA-256 hashes; resolve checks absolute expiresAt and current user status.
createAuthSession uses one configured RIDEX_SESSION_TTL_SECONDS value for all user types; no visible role-specific idle-timeout enforcement in the inspected service.
createAuthSession inserts a session directly; no visible role-specific active-session count check is performed before creation.
AuthSession has tokenHash uniqueness and revocation/expiry fields, but no refresh-token family, consumed-token marker, or rotation lineage fields.
Routes create/revoke opaque sessions; no refresh endpoint/family rotation/reuse-detection flow was found in the inspected route source.

UserType enum is CUSTOMER, DRIVER, ADMIN; Super Admin and Admin Mobile/Web are surfaces/roles rather than distinct UserType values. Session policy must resolve the current AdminUser role and client surface before applying distinct approved limits.

Current login flows return opaque session tokens; no refresh-token endpoint or refresh-token client contract is present in the inspected routes. Adding rotation requires an explicit client/API contract and persistent one-time token-family state, not merely renaming the existing session token.

Session creation currently uses prisma.authSession.create outside the advisory-lock transaction used by revoke-other-session operations. A safe cap requires the same per-user lock around count and insert; idle expiry also needs a defined meaningful-activity signal rather than treating every protected request as activity.

blockers.requirement: Define refresh API/client contract, persist single-use token family/consumption state, atomically rotate, detect reuse and revoke family; add DB-backed race/replay tests.
Resolve surface/privilege classification, then enforce approved limits under a per-user database lock; reject over-limit creation without silent session eviction.
Wire role/surface-specific max lifetime and idle expiry. Only meaningful foreground activity may refresh idle expiry; absolute maximum must never slide.
Database-backed negative/concurrency tests for replay, refresh races, session-limit races, expiry, revocation, suspension and device binding.

scopeLimit: This artifact records a source audit; it does not claim these missing controls have been implemented or runtime-tested.

implementationReadiness.reason: Avoided introducing a partial refresh-token scheme that would break existing bearer-session clients or falsely claim replay/race safety. This iteration strengthens evidence and records the exact implementation dependencies; no production auth behavior is changed by this audit update.
